about: Web tips for the What's here guide. Each tip is tied to a named place. 'place' must match a location name from the map service exactly to get a marker on the map; other places still show in the Guide list. Written in our own words from the sources named.

tips.name: Luffy
tips.text: Luffy is somewhere in Loguetown. Talk to him for a free Rift back into the sky.

tips.name: Usopp
tips.text: Usopp is also in Loguetown, and gives a free Rift too.

tips.name: Loguetown vault
tips.text: A vault here is said to have a Rare Chest holding Usopp's Galaxy Slingshot (Mythic). Another site says the Slingshot only comes from random chests, so check this one yourself.

tips.name: Buccaneer Brigand Jones
tips.text: Slightly south of where the place name sits on the map. He can be hired as a Heavy Specialist.

tips.name: Nami
tips.text: On the beach south of the village. Free Rift.

tips.name: Zoro
tips.text: Zoro is at Arlong Park, on the western tip of the map. Free Rift.

tips.name: Sanji
tips.text: On the eastern part of the southern island. Free Rift.

tips.name: Treasure Hunter Hope
tips.text: Hope is at Lantern Landing and can be hired as a Scout Specialist.

tips.name: A$AP Rocky boss
tips.text: His starting spot changes each match: often the northern part away from the yacht, or on the ship's deck. Beating him can drop the Shock Rocket.

tips.name: Charlotte-Sensei
tips.text: Right by where the ship is docked, not on the ship itself. She can be hired as a Supply Specialist.

tips.name: Map Fragment
tips.text: The first Map Fragment is on the lower decks at the back (stern) of the ship.

tips.name: Buggy boss
tips.text: Beat the Buggy boss for a chance at the Special Buggy Ball (Mythic). This spot replaced Loot Lagoon on Nov 12.

tips.name: Miku and Teto
tips.text: Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto took over this island. Sites disagree on whether they are a boss fight, and one now calls the place Friendship Villa.

tips.name: Lil Uzi Vert boss
tips.text: A walled fort in the north-east, also called Lil' Uzi's Stronghold. Beating Lil Uzi Vert can drop his Lil' SMG.

tips.name: Kawaii Team Leader
tips.text: The only NPC in the north. She can be hired as a Medic Specialist.

tips.name: Oscar boss
tips.text: Oscar arrived as a boss on Nov 22 and drops the Modular Frenzy Auto Shotgun. The articles don't say where his ship is.

tips.name: Gum-Gum Fruit
tips.text: Appears at a random spot once the first storm circle forms, and is marked on the map for every player.

tips.name: Flame-Flame Fruit
tips.text: Appears the same way as the Gum-Gum Fruit. Stay out of water while carrying it.

tips.name: Free Rifts
tips.text: Every NPC this season gives a free Rift, which launches you into the sky so you can glide somewhere new.
